lines: Fine. I will let this end here, but I am not forgetting it.
All right. We can stop before more damage is done.
I accept the payment. Keep your hands peaceful now.
That settles the immediate harm. Trust will take longer.
We have an agreement. Do not give me reason to regret it.
I am stepping back. You should do the same.
This can end quietly if you leave it alone now.
Enough. I will take the offer and close the door on this.
I would rather have peace than another entry in the damage ledger.
Payment accepted. The village still expects better from you.
We are done fighting for today.
I can live with this settlement, though not happily.
All right. Put the weapon away and let the square calm down.
I will call the matter settled for now.
That is sufficient. Do not test how temporary my patience is.
I am choosing calm. Meet me there.
The account is balanced enough to stop this.
Fine. Walk away without another foolish word.
I will take the offer as proof that you want this over.
This ends here, provided your behavior changes with it.
That is not enough. The full amount is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You are still short. Bring {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The settlement requires {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, not a hopeful handful.
Count again. I asked for {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Peace has a clear price here. It is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I will not pretend this covers it. Find {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The amount remains {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Bring the complete payment of {emerald_cost} {emeralds}, then we can speak.
That does not settle the damage. I need {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Your offer falls short of {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I wrote the number plainly. It is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
No bargaining. The cost is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
You cannot close the account without {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
Come back when you have all {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
This is only part of what you owe. The total is {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
I will consider peace when I see {emerald_cost} {emeralds}.
The village agreed on {emerald_cost} {emeralds}. Bring that amount.
Not yet. You need {emerald_cost} {emeralds} to finish this.
Your apology does not make fewer than {emerald_cost} {emeralds} sufficient.
Return with {emerald_cost} {emeralds} and no excuses.
Keep {payment_items}. I am not ready to settle this.
{payment_items} cannot repair what happened while the memory is this fresh.
I do not want {payment_items}. I want distance.
Put {payment_items} away. Trust is not for sale today.
No amount of {payment_items} makes this conversation safe yet.
You can carry {payment_items} back home. My answer is no.
I see {payment_items}, and I still remember the harm more clearly.
Do not wave {payment_items} at me as if the village has forgotten.
{payment_items} may cover damage later. They cannot calm me now.
I will not bargain over {payment_items} while I still fear you.
The record is too recent for {payment_items} to change anything.
Keep hold of {payment_items} until I am willing to speak again.
You brought {payment_items} too soon and understanding too late.
I cannot accept {payment_items} without making peace I do not mean.
{payment_items} do not give you permission to stand this close.
Take {payment_items} and leave before this grows worse.
Payment is not the problem. Keep {payment_items} and give me time.
I will decide later whether {payment_items} belong in any settlement.
Today, {payment_items} are only another thing between us.
The answer remains no, with or without {payment_items}.
